E1_open_set.note: Gallery of same-resolution sensors. 'unseen' removes the image's own sensor, so every match would be a false identification.

E2_threshold_free_held_out.note: 880 negatives resolve false-positive rates down to about 1/880 only; lower operating points are not reported.

E4_incompatible_transforms.note: These are true same-sensor images. Not matching them is the documented behaviour: resampled images are unsupported.
